answer: The lagoon index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1645 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the cipher. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the inlet queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. A farm of 87 pays that 277 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
